title: Match every permitted state in an inheritance family
goal: Use a closed C# hierarchy when one assembly owns the direct states and consumers should match every permitted case. Seal leaves to bound further inheritance.

runtime.reason: The union and closed-family runtime contracts are supplied by .NET 11.
runtime.name: .NET

sdk.reason: Compile the net11.0 application with the SDK family providing C# 15 and matching reference assemblies.
sdk.name: .NET SDK

language.reason: This route uses C# 15 union and closed declarations, stabilized in the canonical RC1 notes.
language.name: C#

prerequisites: Target net11.0 and set LangVersion to 15.0; use framework System.Text.Json and the supplied metadata contexts.
constraints: Closure limits direct inheritance to the declaring assembly; use closed intermediates and sealed leaves.
Inferred discriminators are type-driven; changing from explicit names can change the stored wire contract.
Generated metadata must enable inference at compile time; a runtime-only option cannot repair omitted contracts.
stabilityLimitations: Verified using .NET 11 RC2 artifacts only; GA reconciliation is pending.

selectionNotes: Seal leaves to bound transitive inheritance.
Type-driven discriminator names can change stored contracts.
Source-generated contracts must enable inference during compilation.

evidence.scope: Original case/payload matching and generated-metadata JSON round trips, null/default and ambiguous-object rejection. RC2 additionally executes explicit-registration precedence and missing-generated-inference failure. Exact records captured by eng/Record-Evidence.ps1; eng/Verify.ps1 reruns samples.
